verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents built-in workflows that set fields automatically, plus GraphQL API and GitHub Actions for further control, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations. Templates that copy configured workflows are a duplication feature, not version history or rollback. Using Actions or the API to build versioned automations would be a developer building block, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
